subject: Immediate disconnecting from server on shinyapps.io, but works locally

messages.author: 45af2d102e3d60f5
messages.subject: Immediate disconnecting from server on shinyapps.io, but works locally
parts:
Help.

I cannot figure out why the code below, which is in a web scraping project, immediately disconnects from the server on shinyapps.io. It works fine locally.

Thank you.

ui.R
library(shiny)
library(shinyapps)
library(DT)
library(rvest)
shinyUI(
  fluidPage(
    print("test application to demonstrate problem"),
    sidebarPanel(
     )
  )
)

server.R
library(shiny)
library(shinyapps)
library(DT)
library(rvest)
url <- "http://www.pjm.com/pub/account/lmpgen/lmppost.html"
LMP <- html_table(url %>% read_html() %>% html_nodes(xpath='/html/body/center[4]/table'))
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
})
